("Amtech") (NASDAQ: ASYS), a manufacturer of equipment and consumables enabling AI semiconductor device packaging and advanced substrate fabrication, today announced that its Board of Directors has appointed Guy Shechter as President and Chief Executive Officer, effective August 13, 2026. Guy Shechter joined Amtech in May 2026 as President and Chief Operating Officer. Prior to joining Amtech, he held leadership positions at Yield Engineering Systems from 2021 to 2026, most recently serving as Senior Vice President and General Manager. Before that, he held various leadership roles at Veeco Instruments from 2007 to 2020, including Vice President and General Manager, Global Services Solutions. hits.snippet: **Amtech Systems (NASDAQ: ASYS)**, a supplier of equipment and consumables for AI semiconductor device packaging and advanced substrate fabrication, announced that its Board has appointed **Guy Shechter** as President and Chief Executive Officer, effective **August 13, 2026**. Shechter has also been named to the Board of Directors. Concurrently, **Bob Daigle**, a director since 2021, Non-Executive Chairman since 2022 and CEO since 2023, will transition to the newly created role of **Executive Chairman of the Board**. Following these changes, Amtech’s Board will have six members, four of whom are independent under Nasdaq standards, which the company says supports its focus on corporate governance and independent oversight. According to Amtech, Shechter joined as President and COO in May 2026 and previously held senior leadership roles at Yield Engineering Systems and Veeco Instruments. Read More Shares of Amtech Systems trade on the Nasdaq under the ticker ASYS. © Copyright 2012 - 2026 | citybiz | Terms of Service | All Rights Reserved Amtech Systems has appointed semiconductor industry veteran Guy Shechter as president and chief operating officer, creating a new executive leadership role as the company expands its focus on AI semiconductor packaging and advanced substrate manufacturing. The Tempe, Ariz.-based equipment manufacturer said Shechter will officially join the company May 19 and report directly to CEO Bob Daigle. His appointment signals a continued operational buildout at Amtech as semiconductor equipment suppliers compete for market share in packaging technologies increasingly viewed as critical to AI chip performance. Daigle said Shechter’s background in semiconductor equipment and advanced packaging operations aligns with Amtech’s effort to broaden its product portfolio and scale growth initiatives.
